verdict.rationale: SavvyCal workflows are attached to scheduling links and automatically run multi-action automations on meeting lifecycle events, such as customized reminders and messages, CRM record updates and to-do creation. Zapier triggers and HMAC-signed webhooks extend event-driven actions to outside systems. missing for 10: a documented list of trigger events, conditional rule logic or filters within workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
